### New Integrations


- [Counting Trucks](https://docs.withterminal.com/providers/tsp/counting-trucks)
- [Trackmile](https://docs.withterminal.com/providers/tsp/trackmile)
- [Transit Tracking ELD](https://docs.withterminal.com/providers/tsp/transit-tracking-eld)
- [TXT DashCam](https://docs.withterminal.com/providers/tsp/txt-dashcam)


### Integration Updates


- [DriverBook](https://docs.withterminal.com/providers/tsp/driverbook) now supports[HOS Available Time](https://docs.withterminal.com/models/hos-available-time)
- [ISAAC](https://docs.withterminal.com/providers/tsp/isaac) now maps additional normalized[Driver](https://docs.withterminal.com/models/driver) metadata and location address context on[Historical Vehicle Locations](https://docs.withterminal.com/models/vehicle-location)


### Dashboard Updates


- The[Terminal Dashboard](https://dashboard.withterminal.com/) now adds provider search in Provider Access Control settings
- Canceling pending connection deletion in the[Terminal Dashboard](https://dashboard.withterminal.com/) now returns the connection to` archived` status
- Sync history in the[Terminal Dashboard](https://dashboard.withterminal.com/) now shows backfill as readable durations


### Documentation Updates


- Added[Kafka destination documentation](https://docs.withterminal.com/guides/kafka-destination)
- Added a new guide for[Provider Access Control](https://docs.withterminal.com/guides/provider-access-control)
